senses.gloss:
AS BEING: Expr. By the ins. of subs. s in ता or
by the abl. in other cases:
a. few
अल्पतया;
a.
a child
बालतया;
a. weak
दौर्बल्यात्;
a. wonder-
ful
अद्भुतत्वात्।

AS IF: इव (always after the word it governs):
passed the night as if in a moment
क्षणादिव क्षणदां []
क्षपितवती, K.;
as if painted, as if engraved, as
if paralyzed
लिखितमिवोत्कीर्णमिव स्तम्भितमिव, K.;
as if from hell to heaven
नरकादिव स्वर्गम्, D.

AS FOLLOWS: इति (at the end of the quota-
-tion, which is placed first in Sanskrit).
see R. iii. 47., Ku. iv. 43. Ph.:
began to
speak as follows
वक्तुमित्थमुपचक्रमे वचः, K. xiii.
36.;
Bachaspati spoke a.
वाचस्पतिरवाचेदं, Ku.
ii. 30.

AS FOR, AS TO: विषयः (या, यं)
or
विषयकः (का, कं)
in comp.:
as for his valour, I will not say a
word
तस्य शौर्यविषयं न किञ्चिद् वदामि।

AS SOON AS:
(1) by a comp. adj. with मात्रः (त्रा,
 त्रं),
he who does not put down an enemy or a
disease a. it appears
जातमात्रं न यः शत्रुं रोगं च
 प्रशमं नयेत्, P. i. 8.;
(2) यदा॥।तदैव। Ph.:
a. I spoke
मद्वचनान्तरमेव, K.

AS WELL AS: च॥॥॥चः
anointed with nectar
a. poison
दिग्धोऽमृतेन च विषेण च, Ma. i.;
as a
mother a. as a father
माता च पिता च भूत्वा D. v.
